tools.name: review_url
tools.description: Capture and analyze a URL for UI/UX issues using vision AI.

wait_for.description: CSS selector or 'networkidle' to wait for before capture.

record.description: Record a video of the capture.

format.description: Output format (default: md). 'html' is a polished, shareable report.

max_findings.description: Keep only the top N findings, severity-ordered (agent focus).

max_pr_annotations.description: SARIF only: emit at most N results per report, severity-ordered (reviewer fatigue).

new_only.description: Report only findings not seen in prior runs of the same URL.

tools.name: review_routes
tools.description: Review multiple routes of an application.

max_findings.description: Keep only the top N findings per route, severity-ordered.

max_pr_annotations.description: SARIF only: emit at most N results per route report, severity-ordered.

new_only.description: Report only findings not seen in prior runs of each route.

tools.name: review_flow
tools.description: Run a scripted user-flow review against a URL. Captures frame bursts after every interaction and asks the vision LLM to grade animation quality, missing transitions, loading-state feedback, choreography, smoothness, and flicker. Use this when the user asks about animations, interaction states, or whether a flow feels good — NOT for static design issues (use review_url for those).

url.description: Base URL for the flow (joined with each step's `navigate`).

name.description: Human label for the flow (used in artifact filenames). Default: 'flow'.

steps.description: Inline DSL: semicolon-separated steps. Actions: navigate <path>, click <selector>, hover <selector>, type <selector>=<value>, press <key>, scroll <px>, wait <ms>, capture "<label>". e.g.: 'navigate /signup; type input#email=ada@example.com; click button[type=submit]; wait 1500; capture "after submit"'.

spec_path.description: Alternative to `steps`: path to a flow spec JSON file.

preferences_path.description: Optional path to a markdown file with team motion preferences. Embedded into the prompt and the report's CC handoff block.

consistency.description: Self-consistency samples (1=off, 3=recommended for harder flows). Default 1.

record.description: Record the full Playwright video alongside the contact sheet. Default true.

burst_fullpage.description: Use full-page captures in each burst frame (slower; for in-page scroll animations). Default viewport-only.

tools.name: tune_animations
tools.description: Detect every animation on a page (CSS transitions/keyframes plus Motion One / GSAP / anime.js / @formkit/auto-animate / lottie-web), and write an interactive HTML tuner page where the user can adjust duration/delay/easing live and export a Claude-Code-ready prompt with the parameter changes. Returns the file path of the generated tuner. Use when the user wants to fine-tune existing animation parameters, NOT to review for issues.

settle_ms.description: Time to wait after load for animations to register. Default 1500.

output.description: Where to write the tuner HTML. Default .motionlint/tuner/index.html.

tools.name: get_latest_report
tools.description: Return the most recent UX review report content.
